ways.title: Why choose a Way?
ways.explanation: Each Way shapes your working energy (Mana, Chakra, Nen, Energy), personalizes your agents' collaboration style, and guides the architecture methodology of your projects.
ways.changeNotice: You can switch your Way at any time in your workspace settings.

ninja.name: Way of the Ninja
ninja.desc: Engineered for maximum velocity, eliminating friction, and shipping high-performance code with surgical precision.
ninja.tagline: Channel your Chakra to code at lightning speed.
ninja.philosophy: Maximum execution velocity, zero friction, and instant surgical code iterations.

mage.name: Way of the Mage
mage.desc: Perfect for venturing into bold ideas, prototyping avant-garde concepts, and experimenting with innovative architectures.
mage.tagline: Harness your Mana to forge the extraordinary.
mage.philosophy: Bold creative exploration, modular abstractions, and elegant software design.

hunter.name: Way of the Hunter
hunter.desc: Designed to hunt down the best architectural patterns, evaluate dependencies, and master every engineering choice.
hunter.tagline: Hone your Nen to master every technical decision.
hunter.philosophy: Analytical rigor, tracking technical vulnerabilities, and selecting optimal libraries.

professional.name: Way of the Pro
professional.desc: Built to engineer robust, maintainable, long-lasting foundations adhering strictly to modern software engineering best practices.
professional.tagline: Mobilize your Energy to build bulletproof systems.
professional.philosophy: Strict engineering standards, long-term maintainability, and enterprise robustness.
